panel.anc_unknown_hint: Put a bud in your ear to read the current mode.
panel.basic_hint: These Pixel Buds do not offer the control protocol pbpctrl uses, so only the battery level BlueZ reports is shown.
panel.basic_no_battery: BlueZ reports no battery level. Enable Experimental = true in /etc/bluetooth/main.conf and restart bluetooth.

guidance.not_connected: Open the case or put in a bud to connect your Pixel Buds.
guidance.pbpctrl_missing: Install pbpctrl or set its path in the plugin settings.
guidance.unreachable: The buds are connected but not answering. Take a bud out of the case.

panel.multipoint_caption: Stay connected to two devices at once
panel.ohd_caption: Pause playback when you take a bud out
panel.speech_detection_caption: Switch to Transparency when you start talking
panel.title: Pixel Buds

device.description: Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Leave empty to use the first paired Pixel Buds.
device.label: Device address

hide_when_disconnected.description: Leaves the bar entirely rather than sitting there with nothing to say.
hide_when_disconnected.label: Hide the icon when the buds are not connected

pbpctrl_path.description: Leave empty to find pbpctrl on PATH or in ~/.cargo/bin.
pbpctrl_path.label: Path to pbpctrl

poll_interval.description: Seconds between battery and status checks (minimum 2).
poll_interval.label: Refresh interval

show_percentage.description: Show the lowest bud battery next to the icon.
show_percentage.label: Show battery percentage
